code = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    cells = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg}
    panels = []
    while cells:
        seed = cells.pop()
        todo, comp = [seed], {seed}
        while todo:
            r, c = todo.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in cells:
                    cells.remove(p)
                    comp.add(p)
                    todo.append(p)
        panels.append(comp)
    boxes = []
    for comp in panels:
        rs = [p[0] for p in comp]
        cs = [p[1] for p in comp]
        boxes.append((min(rs), min(cs), max(rs)+1, max(cs)+1))
    size = boxes[0][2] - boxes[0][0]
    fill = grid[boxes[0][0]][boxes[0][1]]
    out = [[fill] * size for _ in range(size)]
    # Later panels replace earlier ones where their marks overlap.
    for r0, c0, r1, c1 in sorted(boxes):
        for r in range(size):
            for c in range(size):
                value = grid[r0+r][c0+c]
                if value != fill:
                    out[r][c] = value
    return out
'''
